summary: Frontend-only test of the redesigned Mission tab ('Creator's Letter') plus a quick check of the Rank PDF after the shared WhatsApp helper refactor. I used Playwright on the web preview at 390x844 and 320x700, signed in as 7004186276. Tapping the Mission tab opens /mission. The order from top to bottom is correct: eyebrow + title, mission-share-top, mission-card, mission-share-bottom, mission-share-more, the 'Poori baat' label, mission-points (6 rows in the requested order) and mission-disclaimer. Both share buttons are red rgb(217,18,34) with the WhatsApp glyph inside and white text 'Please share karo' and 'aur free education ko support karo'. Each line is one line with no overflow at 390 and 320. Neither button says 'with WhatsApp'. Button heights are 66 px at 390 and 64 px at 320; the 'more' link is 44 px. The card ratio is exactly 1.25 at both sizes (340x425 and 288x360). The ribbon text '100% MADE BY AI ASTRA' is fully inside the card corner. At 390 the ribbon starts at x=267 and the eyebrow ends at x=172; at 320 they are at x=221 and x=141, so they do not overlap. No text inside the card overflows or leaves the card, and the 2-line clamped chip lines all fit. The signature, 'Creator, JEELIVE.AI', the gold AP seal, the 4 chips and the footer all render. Document scrollWidth equals the viewport width at 320 and 390. Web share: mission-share-top and mission-share-bottom each open api.whatsapp.com/send?text=... The text starts with '🙏 Please share karo aur free education ko support karo!' and contains https://jeelive.ai. With no navigator.share, mission-share-more copies the caption and shows 'Message copy ho gaya. Kahin bhi paste karke bhej do.' There was no crash and no 'Share nahi khula' error. At the maximum scroll the disclaimer clears the floating Rapid Fire tab (text bottom 741, tab bar 776). Rank regression: College predictor with 180 marks shows rank-pdf and rank-pdf-whatsapp. Tapping rank-pdf-whatsapp downloads JEELIVE-JEE-colleges-180-marks.pdf, opens api.whatsapp.com with the caption and shows a success message. No page errors; the only console message was one 401, which is the existing session probe. No deprecated Expo packages were found.

issues: The smallest card text is very small on screen. The card scales by u=width/320, so at 320 (card 288 px) the chip short lines and the ribbon text are about 6.75 px and the eyebrow and 'Creator, JEELIVE.AI' are about 7.65 px. This is fine for the 1080x1350 shared image but hard to read in the app on small phones. Optional: raise the 7.5u lines to about 8.5u.

action_items: Optional polish: the header comment at /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/mission.tsx:1 still says 'Please share karo with WhatsApp'. Update it to match the UI. This is a comment only and does not show in the app.
Optional: increase the 7.5u chip short-line and ribbon font in /app/frontend/src/mission/MissionCard.tsx:43,56 for on-screen legibility on 320-width phones.
critical_code_review_comments: share.ts web path: Share.share rejects on browsers without navigator.share, which correctly falls back to the clipboard. If Clipboard.setStringAsync were also to reject, the outer catch would show 'Share nahi khula'. That is acceptable.
Native capture paths (captureRef, then react-native-share WhatsApp on the Android build, the iOS share sheet, the Expo Go share sheet) were not tested because they cannot run on web.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: entry-phone-input / entry-pin-input, wait 1.5 s, click entry-continue-button, then goto /mission. To capture WhatsApp URLs on web, override window.open in add_init_script (RN-web Linking.openURL uses window.open). Headless Chromium has no navigator.share, so mission-share-more goes to the clipboard path. The measurement helper is in /app/tests/iter91/measure.js (page.evaluate). Rank PDF: rank-tool-college, then rank-marks-input 180, then rank-show, then rank-pdf-whatsapp, which triggers a download plus the api.whatsapp.com URL and rank-pdf-msg.
